name: Taiki (Mie, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Taiki town emblem in blue, green and red: blue and green curved strokes like a stylised figure, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Taiki, a town in Mie Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 February 2005.

features.role: Taiki town emblem — blue and green curved strokes like a stylised figure, with a red disc
